link.cd14bf8a5e57.source: Memory comes in two tiers. The agent appends raw notes to a dated file under memory/ as it works, then distils the parts that should persist into its curated long-term store, MEMORY.md. The runtime loads MEMORY.md in the main session and leaves it out of any shared or group context, so personal notes stay private. You will read both straight off the live sandbox a few steps down.
link.cd14bf8a5e57.value: 記憶分為兩個層級。代理程式工作時會將原始筆記追加到 memory/ 下按日期命名的檔案中，再把應當長期保留的內容提煉到整理後的長期儲存 MEMORY.md 中。執行階段會在主會話中載入 MEMORY.md，但不會將其納入任何共享或群組上下文，因而個人筆記仍保持私密。稍後幾個步驟中，您將直接從即時沙盒讀取這兩類檔案。

rich.358f62e56c19.source: Those stores differ in reach. Session history belongs to its session. MEMORY.md can carry a saved fact into a new session whose transcript starts empty.
rich.358f62e56c19.value: 這兩種儲存的作用範圍不同。會話歷史只屬於相應會話。 MEMORY.md 可以將已儲存的資訊帶入一個對話記錄為空的新會話。

rich.37cc9edf3743.source: helpers.terminal("bash") opens the host VM shell, where you can run openshell sandbox list.

rich.37dfaa1ff6d5.source: The launchable has two planes of authority. The first is the terminal, which runs as the operator above the sandbox boundary and can therefore read every file and list the sandboxes. The agent occupies the second plane. It shares the machine with the terminal but runs under the narrower OpenShell policy tested in Module 4.
rich.37dfaa1ff6d5.value: 該可啟動執行個體有兩個權限平面。第一個是終端機，它以沙盒邊界上層的 operator 身分執行，因此能夠讀取所有檔案並列出沙盒。代理程式位於第二個平面。它與終端機共享同一臺機器，但受模組 4 中所測試的、更嚴格的 OpenShell 策略約束。

  • or what it remembers about you.

將代理程式的自述視為證據。詢問代理程式的提示詞包含哪些內容，然後在步驟 1b 中將答案與即時工作區進行比較：
  • 當前啟用了哪些角色規則，
  • 工具列表中有哪些工具，
  • 或它記得哪些資訊。

rich.7a5c772b689c.source: Step 1 asked the agent to describe its files, and you do not have to take its word for it. Until now your only channel has been the gateway that carries your messages to the agent.
rich.7a5c772b689c.value: 步驟 1 要求代理程式描述自己的檔案，但您不必完全相信它的說法。到目前為止，您唯一的通道是將訊息傳遞給代理程式的閘道。

rich.8ba8b5ae8e2b.source: Module 3a connected the browser to a persistent runtime. OpenClaw is the agent harness inside that NemoClaw stack: it combines a model and tools with a server-side session and a file-backed workspace.
rich.8ba8b5ae8e2b.value: 模組 3a 將瀏覽器連線到了持久執行階段。OpenClaw 是該 NemoClaw 技術堆疊中的代理程式框架：它將模型和工具與伺服器端會話及檔案支援的工作區結合起來。

rich.ba804a4d7ef6.source: The launchable also exposes an operator terminal, a shell on the host above the agent's sandbox that Cloudflare puts in front of every launchable. The helpers.terminal() helper opens that shell straight from this page through two entry points:
rich.ba804a4d7ef6.value: 該可啟動執行個體還提供 operator 終端機，即代理程式沙盒上層的主機 shell； Cloudflare 會將它置於每個可啟動執行個體之前。 helpers.terminal() 輔助函式可透過兩個入口直接從本頁開啟該 shell：

rich.da8874fc113d.source: The session-key routing here is a lab affordance. NemoClaw's image ships a stash of pre-built SOUL variants and wires a session-key suffix to one of them, only so this page can show two voices in one click. Outside the lab the gateway has no such stash, so two session keys would read the one SOUL.md you have and return two identical replies. In production you change the persona by editing SOUL.md.
rich.da8874fc113d.value: 此處基於會話鍵的路由是實驗專用功能。NemoClaw 映象附帶一組預先建置的 SOUL 變體，並將會話鍵字尾路由到其中一個變體，這只是為了讓本頁能夠一鍵展示兩種表達風格。在實驗之外，閘道沒有這組變體，因此兩個會話鍵都會讀取您唯一的 SOUL.md，並傳回兩個相同的回覆。在生產環境中，您需要透過編輯 SOUL.md 來更改角色。

rich.db0dcea49173.source: helpers.terminal("openshell sandbox connect <agent>") drops you inside the sandbox the agent runs in, where the workspace lives.
rich.db0dcea49173.value: helpers.terminal("openshell sandbox connect <agent>") 會讓您進入代理程式執行的沙盒內部，工作區就位於其中。

rich.e2ab07568e06.source: OpenShell is the kernel-level sandbox that holds the agent. For now you can treat it as the boundary between operator and agent that Module 4 goes on to define in full and to test directly. The agent's name in the connect command comes from GET /api/agent, the same call the Kickstart page made to discover your launchable.
rich.e2ab07568e06.value: OpenShell 是容納代理程式的核心級沙盒。目前，可以將它視為 operator 與代理程式之間的邊界；模組 4 將完整定義並直接測試該邊界。連線命令中的代理程式名稱來自 GET /api/agent，即快速入門頁面用於發現可啟動執行個體的同一呼叫。

rich.eb2a3738197c.source:
This split matters directly for safety. Because the agent can rewrite its own context, the containment layer beneath it has to stop any bad write from doing real harm. OpenClaw freely modifies the markdown in its own workspace, while the OpenShell sandbox beneath it blocks that same write from ever reaching:
  • the host filesystem,
  • the wider network,
  • or a neighbouring agent's workspace.

You will see that boundary tested directly in the next module, where a deliberately over-privileged agent tries to cross it.
rich.eb2a3738197c.value:
這種劃分對安全至關重要。由於代理程式能夠重寫自己的上下文，它下方的隔離層必須阻止任何不當寫入造成實際損害。OpenClaw 可以自由修改自己工作區中的 Markdown，而下層的 OpenShell 沙盒會阻止同樣的寫入觸及：
  • 主機檔案系統，
  • 更廣泛的網路，
  • 或相鄰代理程式的工作區。

您將在下一模組中直接測試這條邊界：一個被刻意賦予過高權限的代理程式將嘗試越過它。

text.d6471f83468f.source:
In one turn the cell below asks OpenClaw to list its own workspace
     files and explain what each one does. Its answer reflects whatever the
     harness folds into its prompt together with whatever its tools can see,
     so editing a file and re-running changes the report.
text.d6471f83468f.value: 下面的單元會在一輪互動中要求 OpenClaw 列出自己的工作區檔案，並說明每個檔案的作用。它的回答既反映框架納入提示詞的內容，也反映其工具能夠看到的內容。因此，編輯檔案後重新執行，報告也會隨之改變。

text.ff5d8859e7af.source:
NemoClaw supplies the blueprint that packages this harness with OpenShell
      and deployment policy. OpenClaw, rather than a separate Python orchestrator, drives each
      turn and reads its workspace files into the active context. You will inspect those files,
      compare two persona configurations, and save memory that survives beyond the model call.
text.ff5d8859e7af.value:
NemoClaw 提供 blueprint，將此框架與 OpenShell
      及部署策略打包在一起。每一輪互動都由 OpenClaw 驅動，而非單獨的 Python 編排器；它還會將工作區檔案讀入當前上下文。您將檢查這些檔案、比較兩種角色設定，並儲存能夠在模型呼叫結束後繼續保留的記憶。
